elements.char: Conclusions
elements.label: text

elements.char: In this paper, we present an innovative airway and vessel generative model to train a CNR for bronchial and vascular
elements.label: text

elements.char: morphological assessment that represents a novel contribution to an unsolved problem that is limiting the application of
elements.label: text

elements.char: image-based techniques for the phenotyping of airway and vessels.
elements.label: text

elements.char: Up-to-date not much work has been proposed in the literature for the assessment of airway and vessel morphology
elements.label: text

elements.char: from CT images. The results obtained with the technique proposed in this work on synthetic images, on the airway
elements.label: text

elements.char: phantom as well as by indirect in-vivo validation, showed that our method accurately and precisely measures the size of
elements.label: text

elements.char: the different structures and may potentially be used for future early diagnosis of lung disorders and to study the level of
elements.label: text

elements.char: resistance and obstruction in small airways and vessels.
elements.label: text

elements.char: An important contribution of this paper is given by the introduction of a 2D generative model that, in combination with a
elements.label: text

elements.char: generative adversarial network, creates axial-reformatted synthetic structures at will with known physical dimension to
elements.label: text

elements.char: train a CNR. The same concept might be extended to other complex problems for which the biological and image-based
elements.label: text

elements.char: knowledge is given, such as pulmonary fissures or cerebral vessels.
elements.label: text

elements.char: For future work, we plan to improve the generation of the synthetic model by reducing the level of approximation of the
elements.label: text

elements.char: PSF and additive noise. Also, a new adversarial method that may help neural networks to be more domain-invariant
elements.label: text

elements.char: when using synthetic data has been recently proposed [
elements.label: text

elements.char: ]. We are planning on implement this idea and compare results
elements.label: text

elements.char: to those obtained in the present paper. Finally, a method to properly validate image-to-image filtering with GANs will
elements.label: text

elements.char: be also investigated.
